title: Communication 11
subtitle: Build practical media skills. Create for an audience, test your ideas, and explain how your work improves.

modules.title: Graphic Design & Photography
modules.summary: Use images, words and design choices to communicate clearly.
modules.description: Start with audience and purpose. Practise layers, masks, colour and typography, then use feedback to refine a visual message. Follow the route your teacher assigns and keep your working files and process evidence.

groups.title: Look closely. Communicate clearly.
groups.description: Build a design vocabulary, then create and test a consistent visual message.

lessons.title: Logo Look
lessons.desc: Study colour, shape and lettering in a logo. Investigate its story and explain your observations in your Google Doc.

lessons.title: Brand Foundations
lessons.desc: Create a style tile, a launch graphic and an adaptation for a fictional client. Test the message, revise and defend your choices.

groups.title: Foundation
groups.description: An introduction to layers, masks and believable depth.

lessons.title: Phone Portal / Out-of-Bounds
lessons.label: Decode the Impossible
lessons.desc: Build an editable phone portal, then bring a butterfly beyond the frame with masks and deliberate layer order.

groups.title: Shared bootcamp
groups.description: Build your workflow, then respond to a changed brief.

lessons.title: Below the Surface
lessons.desc: Create a documentary opener with a layered still, a short motion version and a practical revision.

lessons.title: Drop Day
lessons.desc: Repair a sneaker source, build recoverable masks, and control colour and typography for a product display.

lessons.title: On the Cover
lessons.desc: Design an editorial cover with readable hierarchy, careful portrait masking and purposeful typography.

lessons.title: The Brief Has Changed
lessons.label: Class 10
lessons.desc: Apply your bootcamp learning to a changed brief and explain the choices behind your response.

groups.title: Design exploration & purpose
groups.description: Connect technique to audience, meaning and design choices.

lessons.title: Design Studio Explorer
lessons.desc: Explore the design studio route before moving into more advanced projects.

lessons.title: Make It Matter
lessons.desc: Connect design theory to a cause-advertising project. Explain how your image and words communicate with an audience.

lessons.title: Fresh Impact
lessons.label: ZUNO citrus campaign
lessons.desc: Create an editable citrus product advertisement using paths, label construction, depth, lighting and audience-focused hierarchy.

modules.title: More studio modules
modules.summary: Further projects and module links will appear here as the course progresses. Your teacher will identify the next materials and equipment you need.
